sources.title: GitHub - nathanrs/tiny-diffusion: A character-level language diffusion ...
sources.snippet: A character-level language diffusion model for text generation trained on Tiny Shakespeare, in 365 lines of code! It is only 10.7 million parameters, so you can also try it out locally! This repo also contains a tiny gpt implementation in 313 lines of code. ~80% of the code between the two files are the exact same.
